properties.name: sourceItems
properties.binding: { const result = [] const source = Array.isArray(fetchSuggestions) ? fetchSuggestions : typeof fetchSuggestions === "function" ? internal.remoteItems : Array.isArray(model) ? model : [] for (let index = 0; index < source.length; ++index) { const item = source[index] if (item === null || item === undefined || (typeof item === "object" && item.disabled)) continue const label = typeof item === "object" && item !== null ? item[textRole] : item if (label !== undefined) result.push({ label: String(label), search: String(label).toLowerCase(), value: item }) } return result }

properties.name: suggestions

properties.name: passwordRequirements
properties.binding: Array.isArray(passwordRules) ? passwordRules.map(function(rule) { let passed = false try { if (rule && rule.minLength !== undefined) passed = text.length >= Number(rule.minLength) else if (rule && rule.pattern) { const expression = new RegExp(rule.pattern) passed = expression.test(text) } } catch (error) { passed = false } return {label: rule && rule.label ? String(rule.label) : "", passed: passed} }) : []

description.zh: 包含 label 与 passed 的规则检查结果。
description.en: Rule results with label and passed fields.

properties.binding: Array.isArray(passwordRules) ? passwordRules.map(function(rule) { let passed = false try { if (rule && rule.minLength !== undefined) passed = text.length >= Number(rule.minLength) else if (rule && rule.pattern) { const expression = new RegExp(rule.pattern) passed = expression.test(text) } } catch (error) { passed = false } return {label: rule && rule.label ? description.zh: 通过规则的比例，范围为 0 到 1。

properties.name: passwordRequirements
properties.binding: Array.isArray(passwordRules) ? passwordRules.map(function(rule) { let passed = false try { if (rule && rule.minLength !== undefined) passed = text.length >= Number(rule.minLength) else if (rule && rule.pattern) { const expression = new RegExp(rule.pattern) passed = expression.test(text) } } catch (error) { passed = false } return {label: rule && rule.label ? String(rule.label) : "", passed: passed} }) : []

description.en: Rule results with label and passed fields.

properties.binding: Array.isArray(passwordRules) ? passwordRules.map(function(rule) { let passed = false try { if (rule && rule.minLength !== undefined) passed = text.length >= Number(rule.minLength) else if (rule && rule.pattern) { const expression = new RegExp(rule.pattern) passed = expression.test(text) } } catch (error) { passed = false } return {label: rule && rule.label ? String(rule.label) : "", passed: passed} }) : []

properties.binding: { const result = [] let divided = false for (let index = visibleCount; index < items.length; ++index) { const item = items[index] if (item.separator) { divided = result.length > 0 continue } const action = Commands.actionFor(item) result.push({command: index, text: item.text || (action ? action.text : ""), divided: divided, disabled: !Commands.enabled(item), iconSource: item.iconSource || 0, checkable: !!(action ? action.checkable : item.checkable), checked: !!(action ? action.checked : item.checked)}) divided = false } return result }

properties.name: visibleCount

properties.name: cardPosition
properties.binding: { if (!target) return Qt.point( Math.max(16, (width - stepCard.width) / 2), Math.max(16, (height - stepCard.height) / 2) ) const position = effectivePlacement let left = highlight.x + (highlight.width - stepCard.width) / 2 let top = highlight.y + highlight.height + 14 if (position.indexOf("top") === 0) top = highlight.y - stepCard.height - 14 else if (position.indexOf("left") === 0) { left = highlight.x - stepCard.width - 14 top = highlight.y + (highlight.height - stepCard.height) / 2 } else if (position.indexOf("right") === 0) { left = highlight.x + highlight.width + 14 top = highlight.y + (highlight.height - stepCard.height) / 2 } if (position.indexOf("start") >= 0) { if (position.indexOf("left") === 0 || position.indexOf("right") === 0) top = highlight.y else left = highlight.x } else if (position.indexOf("end") >= 0) { if (position.indexOf("left") === 0 || position.indexOf("right") === 0) top = highlight.y + highlight.height - stepCard.height else left = highlight.x + highlight.width - stepCard.width } return Qt.point(Math.max(16, Math.min(width - stepCard.width - 16, left)), Math.max(16, Math.min(height - stepCard.height - 16, top)))
